About Hotel Shyam

Our Heritage

Established in 1972, Hotel Shyam has been serving authentic Rajasthani, Mughlai & Punjabi cuisine for over 50 years. Our recipes are preserved from generations, cooked with the same love and tradition.

What Makes Us Special

  • Generational recipes unchanged for decades
  • Finest quality ingredients sourced locally
  • Experienced chefs with 20+ years expertise
  • Hygienic kitchen and dining environment
